label: Bug-11
title: CRITICAL: Create Issue modal buttons not working
description:
In v0.1.5, the Create Issue modal is completely broken:

## Symptoms
1. Cannot change issue type (Bug, Task, Feature, etc.) - clicking type buttons does nothing
2. Cannot click the 'Create' button - it doesn't respond
3. Cancel button may also be affected

## Likely Cause
This is probably caused by the Bug-7 fix in v0.1.5 (`create-node-modal.js`) which was supposed to prevent data loss on outside click. The click handler override may be intercepting all clicks on the modal, including button clicks.

## Impact
- **CRITICAL** - Cannot create any new issues in v0.1.5
- Blocks all issue creation workflow

## Reproduction Steps
1. Open Issues UI v0.1.5
2. Click '+ New' button
3. Try to click on any type button (Bug, Task, Feature, etc.)
4. Try to enter a title and click 'Create Task'
5. Nothing happens - buttons don't respond

## Related
- Bug-7: Modal data lost on outside click (the fix that likely caused this)

## Workaround
Use v0.1.4 until this is fixed.
